method_strengths: 真实原生物理、身体碰撞/伤害、资源事务与精确视频绑定已建立。
已有有限反例、原regular、独立相位/噪声留出、候选库重读与版本撤回。
已能保留合法同核心替代，修正checker把动作词当必要性的错误。
LLM提出并实现因果规则，程序做有界生成与验收；没有冒称无界在线发明。

method_gaps.gap: 能力兼容被误当作反冲价值
method_gaps.evidence: M07/M08发布无射；M12/M19职责分别是世界拓扑/顺序。
method_gaps.required_change: 每单独立写自身反冲贡献和实际世界交互贡献；支持性内容可以进入平原，但不占反冲示教证据。

method_gaps.gap: 单一精确接口可靠不等于规则适应空间需求
method_gaps.evidence: 20主选每关系仅一份选定标准Module；兼容的11来自11个不同implementation_source，主要按关系各写一次性脚本。
method_gaps.required_change: 冻结同一规则后接新端口/高差/跨度/净空要求；不为每需求另写case补丁。

method_gaps.gap: 局部噪声/相位留出不覆盖未见几何
method_gaps.evidence: 当前regular留出主要围绕同一候选空间的控制误差/动态初相；不能由36次相位样本推出新空间可生成。
method_gaps.required_change: 分别报告空间留出与各空间内部噪声留出，二者不可互相替代。

method_gaps.gap: 内容职责、节奏和恢复不是technical_family字段
method_gaps.evidence: 旧rendezvous真可靠但原速37.45秒被root暂扣；多数未知方向/恢复状态仍UNKNOWN。
method_gaps.required_change: 五类职责工单、原速等待/行动/失败重试分解、按职责连续状态验证。

method_gaps.gap: 已发生的单案修复尚不能证明稳定修订方法
method_gaps.evidence: 旧补二跳、空中观察、宽岸击退、早射线和相位发布绑定均有撤回；修复成功只证明所修版本。
method_gaps.required_change: 反馈修订冻结后用未参与修订的新空间需求与旧回归同时验收；不从holdout选幸运几何。

roles.name: 先读方向，再用一次反冲落到宽岸
roles.player_decision: 观察瞄准与自身反冲相反，选方向，不同时引入敌人/计时/多机关。
rule_candidates: thorn-slot的宽接收面与真实下方接回地面变体
required_evidence: 目标在操作前可见；关键身体净空与可站区域清楚。
普通跳/步行/错误射向与合法单枪策略在同场景比较；若无需反冲同样完成，则重标为普通通路，不靠purpose拒绝。
失败落至真实安全地面，资源由原grounded恢复，无传送/补枪。
roles.acceptance: 首个方向决策能单独解释到达差异；只要求一个新线索。满足原regular与短视频可读性检查，不声称真人已学会。

roles.name: 同一反冲判断换空间需求
roles.player_decision: 复用已教方向/时机判断，适应跨度、高差或檐边；不是增加动作词。
required_evidence: 相同冻结规则适配至少两个明确不同的空间需求。
每个接口独立counter/regular/噪声留出，不沿用父几何回执。
记录合理操作窗口及成功的同核心替代；不要求逐帧同一串输入。
roles.acceptance: 每份产物满足自己端口、净空、资源和出口合同，保持原因果关系。新增接口不计新家族。

roles.name: 已教反冲与一个世界条件联结
roles.player_decision: 同一枪的移动收益与射线/门/敌人条件需要共同考虑，而非简单串联增加长度。
required_evidence: 只组合已教元素，主职责明确；不以复杂程度代替内容价值。
分别测试提前地面开锁、单独普通跳、射击不进入目标、替代瞄准与漏接。
若新机关只装饰或原判断不再需要，承认实际职责变化。
roles.acceptance: 有可观察的耦合选择和同几何真实替代比较；未教的新元素不同时堆入。仍用原regular。

roles.name: 可见收益的可选反冲支路
roles.player_decision: 在安全主路与需花本次空中枪的取宝路线间选择。
required_evidence: 入支路前看到收益/风险；不取宝主路也真正可走。
真实SimpleRoomReward事务；拿宝后从相同世界状态汇回主路。
失败代价与实际恢复路径记录；不以强制死亡/重建场景替代恢复。
roles.acceptance: 主路/取宝/汇回逐方向验证，资源与一次性敌人/机关状态不重置；UNKNOWN不声称通过。

roles.name: 失误接回、补回原资源并重新尝试
roles.player_decision: 漏接后利用可见地形恢复，再选择重试或返回。
rule_candidates: 现有回程铃/安全落地/下落汇合关系
required_evidence: 明确需要的有向端口与进入资源/世界状态，不强迫所有Module证明通用回程。
不重建场景连续执行去程→失误→恢复→重试/返回，继承HP、冷却、弹药、敌人死亡、门/平台clock。
测漏枪、漏接、晚开门及耗尽机会后的真实恢复，记录恢复耗时与重复等待。
roles.acceptance: 被声明的连续关系真实到达无伤稳定端口；不能把独立满资源反向回放当回程保证。

do_not_infer_from: 无射失败但实际只是门没开/敌人没移开
positive_evidence: 原轨迹中反冲改变自身可达落点/制动/方向/节奏，且与所教判断对应。
同世界/同目标的普通跳、提前地面处理机关、错误/其他合法射向与落点策略真实比较。
成功的不同时间/位置/枪数只要保留同一判断应接受。
recoil_value_evidence_rule.diagnostic_limit: 本报告不发明去掉后坐力的替代物理。组件消融若另做，只能是明确标记的原组件诊断，不能冒充三能力正式候选。

first_bounded_pilot.budget: Each requested space receives4 control candidates; freeze source, reuse original production_loop screen/counters/regular/independent noise holdout and disk reread.
first_bounded_pilot.claim_limit: This is2 relations×2 prelisted new space demands. It can establish finite adaptation examples; no new family and no method-stability conclusion. These visible predefined requests are not an independent unseen-geometry holdout.

method_stability_experiment.scope: Existing production_loop + WorkshopEngine + CandidateLibrary only; no Map Director/Generator.
method_stability_experiment.prior_calibration: Prepare parameter domains and allowed Cell bindings using existing canonical/calibration geometry; freeze rule source, budgets, ranking and protocol before revealing test demands.

unseen_space_benchmark.structure: 3 rules×4 space requirements per rule, revealed only after source freeze; selected inside the predeclared supported domain by a fixed independently recorded selection.
variation_axes: 进场位置/方向与所需离开端口
unseen_space_benchmark.no_posthoc_patch: No per-demand coordinate hacks or rule edits while the test is running; an unsupported or failed request is reported honestly.

method_stability_experiment.per_request_validation: Use fixed equal budget, original regular candidate gate, canonical counter-tested exact witness fixed before independent per-geometry phase/noise holdout. Preserve all failures, hashes, elapsed cost and UNKNOWN fields.
proposed_content_method_acceptance_gates: At least10 of12 unseen supported space requests produce valid regular candidates within the frozen budget, and at least3 of4 per rule. These are proposed finite-benchmark yield gates, not a relaxation of any individual regular gate or a current result.
Zero false admissions: no known actual rewarded cheap bypass hidden only by a purpose tag; all selected module/case/runtime/phase identities and withdrawals match.
For every successful output, a fresh process retrieves the same eligible exact version for the same request; same request/seed does not add a new family or manufacture duplicate output count.
A changed requirement outside a stored candidate contract must trigger re-generation/needs_design, never silently reuse an incompatible candidate.

At least one reviewed artifact covers each of the five declared responsibilities; only return/recovery work orders must prove their requested continuous directed state path. Teaching efficacy remains unproven without play evidence.

Two pre-registered feedback tickets: one actual causal bypass and one pacing/readability issue. Each has evidence, a bounded frozen revision, old-case regressions and new unseen space demands; no reuse of prior holdout for selection.

Record original-speed mandatory waiting, active execution, and miss→recover→retry duration against a role-specific time budget fixed before the batch. A technical pass exceeding its budget is pacing_held, not renamed successful or treated as human disapproval.

separate_generalization_axes.unseen_geometry: New requested space/ports/clearance not used to write or tune this frozen rule revision. Tests content adaptation.
separate_generalization_axes.noise_and_phase_holdout: Independent controller error/dynamic phases inside a particular geometry. Tests local tolerance.
separate_generalization_axes.reuse_repeatability: Fresh process exact request/version/source validation. Tests artifact reproducibility, not new content.
separate_generalization_axes.feedback_revision: A new source version prompted by actual evidence, then old regressions plus new withheld spaces. Tests controlled improvement, not online learning.

report_metrics: unique geometry coverage and rejected cheap routes
source edits/manual patches and wall-clock cost
pacing decomposition and actual recovery time
method_stability_experiment.method_claim_if_passed: Repeatable bounded plains-content process within the tested rule/domain/role scope; not universal autonomous invention, human fun, production approval, or full-map readiness.
